scope.boundary: Recurring common capability/resource behavior, recording-path contracts, implementation boundaries and cross-capability inputs/handoffs.
scope.coverage_claim: Parent scenarios describe recurring behavior and selected interactions, not a requirement-count quota or all Skill-family methods. Scoped rollout, source-transfer and before/after simplification acceptance remain with their owning change. Linked methods establish only their stated boundaries; proposed reviews and partial setup/diagnostic gaps remain explicit.

fixture_rules.isolation: Each automated variant uses fresh temporary mutable state or read-only authored fixtures; register cleanup immediately. Review uses exact source identities and synthetic counterexamples.
fixture_rules.independent_expectations: Expected values/diagnostics and allowed decisions come from the owner, not validator lookup tables or production transformations.
fixture_rules.negative_setup: Validate the same otherwise-valid setup before the defining mutation when claiming fault isolation; disclose absent baseline proof as a realization gap.
fixture_rules.version_roles: Version and draft-format literals select a current representation or synthetic fixture role; they do not generate historical-version matrices.
fixture_rules.resource_boundary: Fixture paths belong to the private root; owner/target/test references identify repository source. JSON prose is never an executable command or expression.
